content.comment_body: Good morning, I am using a [product_name] with 8 analog inputs and a communication module and have created a page using [product_name] Web Editor. After downloading it to the memory card of the controller, I tried to access it remotely through VPN, but the web page does not appear as if it was downloaded. Could the data log file be removing my web editor files to free up space for backups? Any advice would be appreciated.
It's challenging to understand your description. What does the diagnostics function of the [product_name] indicate about the condition of the SD card?
There is a write/read error with the memory card.
The [product_name] uses a microSD card instead of an MMC. If you are experiencing read/write errors, the web editor cannot save its project on the SD card.
I have checked the memory card, and the web editor file is present, but I am unable to access the page on the [product_name] site for some reason.
Are you able to access other web servers on the [product_name]? Also, are the necessary ports enabled on your VPN?

Thank you for responding. The default web page provided by [company_name] is accessible through the VPN. I can also log in to [product_name] and view input readings, but only the web editor-generated page is inaccessible.

That's unusual. Both pages use the same ports. If one web server works, the other should as well. Issues with the web server seem to be happening more frequently in recent versions. Consider starting a support request. Regards, [user_name]

Hi, As long as your [product_name] does not work with the SD card, you won’t be able to use the [product_name] Web Server. The web server project is stored on the SD card. Make sure your SD card is 32GB or less, formatted according to the [product_name] manual, and is accepted by the device. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties accessing pages created with [product_name] Web Editor via VPN, even though the default web server remains accessible. The issue is linked to the microSD card experiencing read/write errors, which prevents the web editor files from loading properly, as they are stored on the card. There is some confusion about file handling and the effect of data-logging on file storage, but the key problem is an inaccessible web editor page due to storage-related issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect uninterrupted access to the web pages generated by [product_name] Web Editor via VPN, just as they can access the standard web pages, and are seeking confirmation that data-logging will not interfere with storing web editor files.
